answer: Every identity posts a heartbeat per epoch: proof of work tied to a fresh random beacon. Like a willow in wind, it proves one live device. A thousand fakes need a thousand heartbeats at 2 tokens each — 2,000 per epoch; an honest agent pays only 2. Miss two and the identity stands on a ledge, frozen, then slashed. Heartbeats are hashed against a quartz-clear public seed anyone can audit. Honest agents pay once; attackers pay forever.
